title: Western Blot Protocol
author: Athan Dial
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rh3d38n
materials: Block reagents and concentration will vary depending on antibodies. Usually 10 mL of block solution per plate.

steps.title: Prepare Gel and Apparatus
steps.instruction: Set up the gels using the power pack instructions, ensuring the short plate faces in on the apparatus.

substeps.instruction: Press the gel against the gasket.
Press down and close the arms simultaneously.
Place the unit into the bucket.
Use a thick plastic plate as a 'dummy plate' if fewer than 2 gels are used.
Gently and straight pull out the comb to avoid collapsing wells.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the protein separation at a constant 60 V for 02:15:00 at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Fill the inner chamber with fresh 1x running buffer high enough to cover the smaller plate and enter the wells.
Load protein ladder in the rightmost lane (note: final product will have ladder on the leftmost lane).
Load samples using gel-loading tips at a consistent amount, drawing and ejecting samples slowly to avoid bubbles.
Fill the bucket with 'used' 1x running buffer.
Place the lid on the tank with matched color-coded leads and run the machine.

steps.title: Prepare Transfer Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of 1x transfer buffer with MeOH using Distilled Water, Methanol, and 10x Transfer Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Store the transfer buffer in freezer #2 (bottom rack) at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Membrane and Gel for Transfer
steps.instruction: Prepare the PVDF membrane and gel for the transfer sandwich.

substeps.instruction: Activate the PVDF membrane by placing it in methanol on a rocker using tweezers.
Fill a wide plastic tray with 1x transfer buffer.
Soak 6 filter papers per cassette in the 1x transfer buffer.
Carefully remove the gel from between glass plates using a green plastic wedge.
Soak gels and sponges in transfer buffer for 5 minutes to equilibrate.

steps.title: Assemble Immunoblot Sandwich
steps.instruction: Assemble the sandwich in the blot cassette with the black (cathode) side down.

substeps.instruction: Place 2 sponges.
Place 3 sheets of soaked filter paper (roll out bubbles).
Place the gel (ladder on the right, dye front on the bottom).
Place the PVDF membrane over the gel using tweezers.
Place 3 sheets of soaked filter paper (roll out bubbles).
Place 2 sponges.
Close the cassette and leave it in transfer buffer until all cassettes are assembled.

steps.title: Perform Protein Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from gel to membrane at a constant 90V for 01:30:00 in the cold room.

substeps.instruction: Set up the power pack.
Fill the bucket approximately 3/4 full with transfer buffer.
Add a magnetic stir bar and an ice pack to the bucket.
Ensure electrodes are correctly placed.
Start the reaction; small bubbles should be visible at the start.

steps.title: Stain and Rinse Membrane
steps.instruction: Visualize the transfer and clean the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place the membrane onto a plate with tweezers and add used amido black.
Place the plate on the rocker for 1 minute.
Cut the membrane with an exacto-knife if necessary and take a picture.
Draw excess amido black back into the bottle.
Rinse the membrane with distilled water.

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Place the membrane on a rocker with TBS-T to keep it moist.
Remove TBS-T and add block solution.
Incubate on the rocker for 01:00:00.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with primary antibody in the cold room for 14:00:00 to 18:00:00.

substeps.instruction: Defrost primary antibody solution 5 minutes before the block incubation is complete.
Remove block solution and add primary antibody solution.
Incubate on a rocker overnight in the cold room, keeping the bottle for reference.
Remove primary antibody using a 10mL pipette and return the solution to its tube.

steps.title: Wash Membrane (Post-Primary)
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove unbound primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 1x TBS-T to the membrane and incubate on the rocker for 00:05:00.
Repeat this wash step 3 times in total.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with secondary antibody for 01:00:00 on a rocker.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of secondary antibody solution (diluent and % mass vary based on primary antibody used), ensuring no contamination.

steps.title: Wash Membrane (Post-Secondary)
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane to remove unbound secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 1x TBS-T to the membrane and incubate on the rocker for 00:05:00.
Repeat this wash step 3 times in total.

steps.title: Prepare for Imaging
steps.instruction: Prepare the imager and ECL solution.

substeps.instruction: Keep membranes in TBS-T but remove from the rocker.
Turn on the computer and autofocus the imager with the Mac card.
Clean the square plate with EtOH to ensure no particulate matter.
Prepare ECL solution in a black tube by mixing Luminol and Clarity using a pipette with fresh tips.

steps.title: Develop and Image Membrane
steps.instruction: Apply ECL solution and capture the protein signal.

substeps.instruction: Dab excess TBS-T off the membrane with a KimWipe and place it in the square plate.
Cover the membrane by pipetting ECL solution in a drop-wise fashion.
Place a container over the plate to avoid light and incubate for 00:05:00.
Using tweezers, place the membrane on the glass and position the glass in the middle of the tray on the 3rd level of the machine.
Take and save a preview image to see the ladder.

steps.title: Store Membrane
steps.instruction: Preserve the membrane for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Soak the membrane in 100% methanol.
Leave on a KimWipe to dry.
Wrap the membrane in plastic wrap, label it, and store at room temperature (RT).
